versus.helpText: Agregati: count(), countIf(uslov), sum(x), sumIf(x, uslov), avg(x), min(x), max(x), median(x), percentile(x, 90), stdev(x), distinct(kolona), presence() (sekunde), players(), matches(), rounds(), kills(), deaths(), winRate(). Stope: perMinute(v), perMatch(v), perRound(v), perPlayer(v), ofAll(v) (udio reda All), shrink(a, b, 4) (a / b povučeno prema cjelini tamo gdje počiva na malo podataka). Aritmetika + - * / među agregatima; uslovi s == != < > i or not in; tekst u navodnicima. 'where' filtrira svaki agregat: avg(speed) where alt > 1000.
